notes.title: Minor Update - V 1.00.17
notes.content:
- New dynamic notification system that eliminates pauses in tutorial texts and in several specific cases. Documents and GPM texts continue to pause the game to allow the player to pay more attention to them. The notification system also adds additional information in specific cases to make it easier for the user to understand what they need to do or if they have picked up any important items.

- Easier final boss.

- Fixes in the environment of the final cinematic.

- Various bug fixes in menu screens and options.

notes.title: // Major Performance Update!! // SymbioPhobiA V 1.00.16
notes.content: Great optimization throughout the game for smoothness, stability, and higher FPS rates.

notes.title: // Minor update: 1280x720 screen resolution now available //
notes.content: Added 1280x720 screen resolution to the graphics settings.

notes.title: //Important Update: Performance + Easier Final Boss //
notes.content:
- [b]Improved Performance[/b]: Create new LODs and adjust their distance; Lightmap UV's retouched and improved; Lighting retouched. Of course, it is important to remember that the graphics configuration depends on the PC and that what consumes the most are Vsync and Shadows. I also specify that I have NOT optimized the particles of the Explosions, so when there is an explosion the performance DOES decrease.

- [b]Easier Final Boss[/b]: Normal attacks take less health; Spin attack takes less health; The boss recovers less health. Now it must not be very difficult to defeat the Final Boss, but remember that many times it is preferable not to stop firing even if there is little power in the weapon than a lot of power with a long reload time. Use your own strategies.

- Fixed an issue with entering the room on the F1 floor of the East Area that would sometimes not open when pressing the "E" key.

notes.title: Hotfix SymbioPhobiA V 1.00.13 // Fixed some bugs in the aiming system.
notes.content:
[b]Fixed[/b] some bugs in the [b]Aiming[/b] [b]System[/b].

The aiming system sometimes failed causing the precision aiming to be blocked or the player to be turned looking in a different direction to where he was shooting.

notes.title: \\ Hotfix SymbioPhobiA V 1.00.12 \\ Fixed low graphics settings
notes.content:
- Low graphics settings no longer drastically change the game's lighting. 
- The post-processing of the lighting has been changed a bit to boost the light areas a bit without making the dark areas look too light.

notes.title: // Hotfix SymbioPhobiA V 1.00.11 // Stair Puzzle + Illumination
notes.content:
- Fixed a puzzle where pulling a metallic stair would end up going through the player character.
- Fixed metal ladder collisions.
- The ilumination of the entire game is now clearer.

notes.title: //Added clue in the first puzzle of the East Area. More action at first time//
notes.content:
Because people get stuck on the first puzzle (which is really a tutorial area) and they start to get bored, I've made this first puzzle a bit easier by making it more obvious what you want to achieve. In addition, the action starts earlier to make the start more varied and entertaining. I hope these changes make the initial experience more enjoyable since the really interesting part of the game starts after that area.

I hope you don't despair and are understanding.

notes.title: // Hotfix of the initial lifebar filled percentage //
notes.content:
The character's starting health amount has been changed. It seems that it was not understood that the initial life was almost at the minimum to force the use of the inventory and the medkit.

Sorry for the inconvenience!
